correctness.rationale: Positive primitive L=(1-delta)I+beta A has Lv=v. The exact product-union bound F(x)=Lx-H(x), H>=0, gives monotonically decreasing Perron mass a=v^T x. Nonzero limiting mass contradicts uniform positivity propagation and strictly positive H. Stable spectral modes are O(a²) and z/a->0. Expanding independent-neighbor product yields collision quadratic H_2 projected to K=delta[1-delta(1+1/rho)/2]sum v_i³; then 1/a increments ->K and t a->1/K. Own independent n=2 edge and n=3 path numerical nonaligned states at t=30000 agree to 0.03%; cannot prove infinite n. Original checker.py and pinned proof inspected.
residual_risks: The full general proof requires connected undirected fixed graph and 0<delta<1; delta=1 boundary excluded. The derivation depends on product not an additive epidemic approximation.
